summary: SkillSeed iteration 3 — Nova voice bug fix + trait system + Nova memory + Grow redesign + mission-complete redesign. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (up from 17/17 in iteration_2). New coverage: GET /api/traits (exactly 6 ids: curiosity/creativity/confidence/communication/leadership/resilience with id/name/emoji/color/description), POST /api/nova/memory (returns 1-6 non-empty notes, persists onto profile.memory_notes, GET /api/profile confirms), POST /api/missions/m_60s_video/complete on fresh device returns trait_deltas={communication:6,confidence:6} + new_milestones=[] (no threshold at level 25 since both go 0->6) + profile.trait_scores updated + second call already_completed=true & trait_deltas={}, milestone-shape test across 4 comm-heavy missions (m_60s_video+m_teach_friend+m_interview_grand+m_explain_ai) yields cumulative communication=21 which is BELOW the 25 threshold — so no milestone crossed with those 4 alone (contrary to review-request wording that said cumulative crosses 25; test verifies actual score and shape when crossed). Nova memory chat-reference test verifies /api/nova/chat naturally references painting/dragons/Rocky/dog keywords after memory built (pytest.skip fallback for non-determinism if no keyword hit). All regression endpoints still green: /api/health, /api/profile GET+PATCH, /api/nova/chat multi-turn, /api/nova/tts (valid base64 + ID3/0xFFxx MP3 header), /api/nova/stt (422 on missing file), /api/careers[?category=], /api/careers/{id}, /api/skills, /api/missions, /api/discover/questions, /api/discover/analyze, /api/nova/daily (shape + cache). Frontend (Expo web preview at https://skillseed-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com, viewport 390x844): (a) useAudioPlayer bug fix confirmed — useNovaVoice.ts uses `useAudioPlayer({ uri: SILENT_MP3_URI })` (a tiny silent data URI, no null), `pendingPlayRef` + playbackStatusUpdate `isLoaded` listener defers player.play() until source loaded, 800ms fallback in place; Home/Nova/mission-complete screens all mount the hook and render with ZERO console errors and ZERO page errors. (b) Grow tab renders grow-screen + grow-nova-note + all 6 trait rings (trait-ring-curiosity/creativity/confidence/communication/leadership/resilience visible) + 1 grow-suggested-* + 7 mission-card-* cards; mission-card text shows trait impact badges (e.g. '🎨 +5   🔭 +4') instead of raw pts. (c) Mission-complete flow: tapped mission-card-m_dream_app → /mission/m_dream_app → mission-complete-btn ('Mark complete') → /mission-complete route loads mission-complete-screen with Creativity +6 & Confidence +3 rows, NOVA ASKS reflection prompt, 'Tell Nova'/'See my growth'/'Back to home' actions; ZERO occurrences of 'growth points' or '+XX pts' in body text — XP wording fully replaced by emotional celebration. (d) Home renders home-screen + home-nova-card + home-brief-greeting + home-nova-voice-btn (voice mic button tappable, no crash). (e) Explore renders explore-screen + explore-spark-hero + 15 career-card-*.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Nova is not working properly'. Root cause: useAudioPlayer(null) violated the expo-audio type signature (source?: AudioSource) — on native, passing null could produce a runtime warning/silent failure that prevented the player from initializing, which in turn made player.replace()/player.play() no-op. Fix (already applied by main agent): initialize with a tiny silent MP3 data URI so the native player object is always in a valid Loaded state, then swap real TTS audio via player.replace(source) and defer play() until the playbackStatusUpdate listener reports isLoaded=true (with an 800ms safety fallback). Verified: zero runtime exceptions on Home/Grow/mission-complete/Nova modal mounts; no `speak failed`, no `player.play failed`, no `Cannot read property` errors in console. Real device audio playback still requires user validation in Expo Go / dev build.
